# What should you charge for a brand deal?

> Free influencer brand deal rate calculator. Enter your follower count, engagement rate, and platform to get a price range for a feed post, Story, Reel/short video, and dedicated video — based on commonly cited creator-economy CPM benchmarks. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
